pages.text: The $(bold)Bitwise$() gates (AND, OR, NOT, XOR, XNOR, plus the $(bold)Bitwise Diode$()) operate on a whole $(l:3_wiring/bundled)bundled cable$() at once — sixteen channels processed in parallel through one block.$(br2)This is how you do real computation in More Red without a wall of single-line gates.
pages.title: Sixteen at Once
